set.body:
Two @param claims are the opposite of what the code does.

1. R/fmrilm.R:524 - "ar_voxelwise ... (overrides ar_options$voxelwise)".
   It does not. R/fmrilm.R:316 applies it only if "voxelwise" is absent from
   ar_options, so the list wins:
     ar_voxelwise=TRUE + ar_options=list(voxelwise=FALSE) -> FALSE
   This matters: a reader would believe they had forced voxelwise estimation.

2. R/fmri_lm_runwise.R:17 and R/fmri_lm_chunkwise.R:16 both say
   "Default is FALSE" for use_fast_path. The actual defaults
   (fmri_lm_runwise.R:25, fmri_lm_chunkwise.R:26, and fmri_lm() itself) are TRUE.

The real rule is uniform - the options list always wins over every shorthand
(cor_struct, cor_iter, cor_global, ar1_exact_first, ar_p, ar_voxelwise). Document
that rule once, in one place, rather than per-argument.
set.title: Docs: ar_voxelwise and use_fast_path contradict behaviour
